title: PlanLimitPayload

runId.description: A run's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when the run starts or is adopted.

window.description: The plan window, in the provider's words: five_hour, seven_day.

status.description: A plan window's verdict: allowed, warning (near the limit), or rejected (over it until the reset).

utilisation.description: How much of the window is used, 0 to 1 and beyond, when the provider says.

anyOf.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

description: plan.limit: the provider reported a rate-limit verdict for a plan window.
